name: TasTAFE fee concession
summary: Reduced TasTAFE tuition fees on subsidised courses for students on Centrelink payments, Health Care Card holders and listed dependants.
who: Receiving certain Centrelink allowances or pensions, such as Youth Allowance
Listed as a dependant on a current Centrelink card
Holding a current Health Care Card or DVA Pensioner Concession Card
how: Produce Centrelink evidence relevant to your benefit or allowance at enrolment.
catches: Not available for commercial or unsubsidised courses.
Concession fees are only payable once in a 12-month period for each course.
Textbooks, workbooks and protective clothing are not covered.

evidence.quote: Fee concessions are offered based on your (or your family’s) Centrelink status.
concessions are not available for commercial/unsubsidised courses
are receiving a Centrelink allowance such as Newstart, Youth Allowance
